correctness.rationale: The domination complex was independently rebuilt from all 2^15 labeled graphs on six vertices. Exactly 4502 nonempty simplices occur, with face counts 15,105,455,1185,1647,915,180. Replaying the package's staged edge matching produced 2181 disjoint pairs, a full 21300-cover Hasse orientation with no directed cycle, and exactly one critical 0-cell, 115 critical 4-cells, and 24 critical 5-cells. Independent integer algebraic Morse reduction gave the entire C_5^M to C_4^M differential as zero. Hence the 4-skeleton is a wedge of 115 four-spheres; it is 3-connected, so Hurewicz identifies pi_4 with H_4 and each zero Morse-boundary column makes the corresponding 5-cell attaching map null-homotopic. The claimed mixed-dimensional wedge follows.
residual_risks: The theorem is a complete finite result only for D_{6,3}; it does not classify the family D_{n,k}.
